they believe are linked to the gunman.

CEO of the US's largest private health insurer Mr Thompson, who lived in a 
suburb of Minneapolis, Minnesota, was named chief executive of 
UnitedHealthcare in April 2021. He made $10.2m (£8m) from the company last 
year. In 2022, he made $9.8m and in 2021 he made $9.6m.
